item.title: Warrior Brewing Company to close taproom ahead of relocation
item.description: DULUTH, Minn. — Warrior Brewing Company has announced that its taproom in Lincoln Park will be closing ahead of a relocation. item.title: St. Louis County welcomes new deputies and corrections officers
item.description: DULUTH, Minn. — The St. Louis County Sheriff’s Office swore in new sheriff’s deputies and correctional officers.
